heritage.name: Qutub Minar & Complex
heritage.summary: World's tallest brick minaret at 72.5 meters surrounded by ancient funerary and ceremonial monuments, including the 4th-century rust-resistant Iron Pillar.
heritage.historical_significance: Marks the establishment of the Delhi Sultanate in 1192 CE. Contains inscriptions in Parso-Arabic and Nagari characters recording historic repairs.

heritage.name: Red Fort (Lal Qila)
heritage.summary: Massive red sandstone citadel served as the seat of the Mughal Empire for nearly 200 years and the traditional venue for the national Independence Day address.
heritage.historical_significance: Constructed when Shah Jahan shifted his capital from Agra to Shahjahanabad. Witnessed key historic epochs from Mughal zenith to the 1857 First War of Independence.

heritage.name: Humayun's Tomb
heritage.summary: The first monumental garden tomb on the Indian subcontinent, establishing the architectural prototype that culminated in the Taj Mahal.
heritage.historical_significance: Commissioned by Empress Bega Begum for Emperor Humayun. Reached modern renown following landmark AKTC conservation that revived the historic waterways.
heritage.creator: Muhammad Mahdi Karim

heritage.name: India Gate & National War Memorial
heritage.summary: 42-meter-high triumphal arch honoring over 84,000 soldiers, standing at the eastern terminal of Kartavya Path with the adjoining National War Memorial.
heritage.historical_significance: Commemorates soldiers of the British Indian Army who lost their lives in the First World War and Third Anglo-Afghan War, inscribed with over 13,000 names.

nature_parks_zoo.name: National Zoological Park Delhi
nature_parks_zoo.summary: A 176-acre historic conservation zoological park adjacent to the 16th-century Purana Qila, housing over 1,300 animals across 130 species.
nature_parks_zoo.historical_significance: Inaugurated on November 1, 1959 under Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru; designated as the National Zoological Park in 1982.
nature_parks_zoo.attribution: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Govt of India
